verification_policy: The checked-in snapshot validates schema, citation-key linkage, DOI/URL shape, source-to-entry lineage, exact supported claims, and explicit limitations. entries.engineering_basis: Parameterized ambiguous silhouette; not a pixel-identical reproduction of a historical plate.
evidence_limitations: The generator verifies geometry and luminance, not bistable reports.
entries.supported_claim: The entry instantiates a controllable ambiguous-figure stimulus family.

entries.engineering_basis: Equal central patches on unequal luminance surrounds.
evidence_limitations: Display calibration and observer adaptation are not modeled.
entries.supported_claim: The physical center patches are matched while surround luminance differs.

entries.engineering_basis: Alternating rectangular masks at a fixed rational frame rate.
evidence_limitations: The artifact establishes temporal succession, not perceived motion.
entries.supported_claim: The sequence contains controlled successive spatial events.

entries.engineering_basis: Additive octave-spaced partials with a deterministic envelope.
evidence_limitations: Playback transducers and listener pitch judgments are external.
entries.supported_claim: The audio contains octave-related partials with controlled sweep parameters.

entries.engineering_basis: Harmonic components are synthesized while the nominal fundamental is omitted.
evidence_limitations: Pitch completion is an observer-level inference.
entries.supported_claim: The nominal fundamental component is absent from the canonical spectrum.

entries.engineering_basis: One flash paired with one or two timed beeps on a shared clock.
evidence_limitations: The stimulus does not establish a reported flash count.
entries.supported_claim: The declared beep/flash event counts and offsets are physically encoded.

entries.engineering_basis: Stereo panning and visual displacement encode a spatial discrepancy.
evidence_limitations: Perceived localization depends on room, headphones, display, and observer.
entries.supported_claim: The audio and visual channels carry a declared spatial discrepancy.

entries.engineering_basis: Equal bars with controlled arrow-wing geometry.
evidence_limitations: The chosen normalized geometry is one engineering variant.
entries.supported_claim: The two bar lengths are equal in the canonical raster while wing geometry varies.

entries.engineering_basis: A diagonal continuation is separated by a rectangular occluder.
evidence_limitations: Alignment judgments and orientation filters are not measured.
entries.supported_claim: The occluder and diagonal continuation are generated from explicit geometry.

entries.engineering_basis: Equal target bars are placed inside converging rails.
evidence_limitations: Perspective interpretation is observer- and display-dependent.
entries.supported_claim: Target bars are physically equal and rails converge toward a vanishing region.

entries.engineering_basis: Three incomplete circular inducers are rasterized around a triangular gap.
evidence_limitations: Illusory contour completion is not directly measured.
entries.supported_claim: The image contains incomplete inducers with no explicitly drawn triangle edge.

entries.engineering_basis: Equal central targets are surrounded by different context-circle sizes.
evidence_limitations: Perceived size depends on viewing scale and context.
entries.supported_claim: Central target geometry is held equal while contextual circle geometry differs.

entries.engineering_basis: Vertical long lines crossed by short oblique inducers with explicit normalized spacing and angle.
evidence_limitations: The raster verifies line geometry, not orientation judgments or a pixel-identical historical reproduction.
entries.supported_claim: The entry instantiates a controlled crossing-line orientation stimulus family.

entries.engineering_basis: Two octave-complex tones are separated by a half-octave interval.
evidence_limitations: Ascending/descending reports vary across listeners and contexts.
entries.supported_claim: The canonical pair has an explicit half-octave frequency relation.

entries.engineering_basis: Alternating high and low tones are assigned to opposite stereo channels.
evidence_limitations: The auditory percept depends on dichotic presentation and listener.
entries.supported_claim: The two channels receive alternating octave-related tones.

entries.engineering_basis: An interrupted sinusoidal carrier is replaced during a declared gap by a deterministic tone or white-noise masker with typed amplitude.
evidence_limitations: The generator reports the physical interruption and masker, not a listener's continuity judgment or sensory-versus-decisional effect.
entries.supported_claim: The canonical audio contains a reproducible interruption interval and masker family.

entries.engineering_basis: A visual flash and audio click share a clock with explicit offset.
evidence_limitations: The generated single-event pair is a simplified engineering stimulus.
entries.supported_claim: Audio and video event timing and declared offset are deterministic and inspectable.

entries.engineering_basis: Requires validated speech audio/video fixtures and licensing records.
evidence_limitations: No fixture, consent record, or perceptual validation contract is bundled.
entries.missing_contract: A licensed or consented checksummed speech audio/video fixture, synchronization contract, and preregistered perceptual validation protocol are required.
entries.supported_claim: The catalog identifies a speech-dependent audiovisual family without claiming implementation.
